_about: Psychological thriller: a lie at the center, a memory that cannot be trusted, and a twist that changes everything. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

lie: the accident was never an accident
the missing wife left on her own
the hero's alibi was invented by someone else
the child in the photos is not theirs
the dead brother is still alive
the will was rewritten the night before
the hero signed the papers themselves
who_benefits: the kind neighbor who always helps
the spouse who handles all the money
the therapist with too many notes
a business partner buying out the company
a younger sibling next in line
the detective assigned to the case
an old friend who came back to town
the hero, in a way they cannot face
forgotten: the night of the party in Pattaya
three hours after the car crash
the last call with their mother
why they own a key to that flat
who was in the room when it happened
the year they lived in Penang
what they buried in the back garden
the face of the person they saw running
twist: the hero is the one being protected
two people are sharing one identity
the helper is the cause of it all
the memory was planted in therapy
the hero did it and forgot
the stalker is trying to warn them
all of this has happened once before
who_knows: a housekeeper who saw and was paid to forget
a taxi driver who drove them home that night
an ex who still has the old phone
a nurse on the night shift
a child who keeps drawing the same picture
a pharmacist who filled a strange prescription
a stranger who sends letters with no name
deadline: the insurance payout clears in three days
the house is sold at the weekend
the police reopen the case tomorrow
the flight leaves Suvarnabhumi at midnight
the pills run out at the end of the week
the anniversary of the death is coming

1: a small detail does not match what they remember
a stranger seems to know them
2: proof that someone close lied to them
the gap in their memory opens wider
3: the one they trusted is not who they seemed
the evidence now points at them
4: the truth behind the lie comes out
they choose what to do with the twist

cliches: the narrator was dead all along
a mirror cracks as the hero remembers
